ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Microsoft is a technology company whose mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

We strive to create local opportunity, growth, and impact in every country around the world across our three operating segments.

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

Our operations are subject to risks related to cybersecurity threats, including sophisticated threat actors targeting cloud platforms.

Intense competition across all markets for software, devices, and cloud services may reduce our market share and margins.

Changes in international trade policies, tariffs, or governmental sanctions could impact our global supply chains and partner ecosystem.

ITEM 1B. UNRESOLVED STAFF COMMENTS

None.
